recognize_zh: 這是臨床照片組合：臉部、額頭、軀幹多處紫紅色結節與斑塊，並有部分照片顯示病灶消退；年長男性合併這種瘀青樣紫色皮膚病灶，要想到 BPDCN。這不是顯微鏡形態學圖片。
features: Eight-panel composite of clinical photographs of an older man
Multiple violaceous to purplish-red nodules and plaques on the face, forehead, and scalp margin
Numerous disseminated erythematous to violaceous papules and nodules on the chest and abdomen
Panels showing regression of lesions with residual hyperpigmentation and erythema, suggesting response to therapy
No histologic or cytologic information in this image
describe_en: Composite clinical photographs show multiple violaceous, bruise-like nodules and plaques involving the face, forehead, and trunk, with disseminated erythematous papules over the chest and abdomen. Other panels show marked regression of the lesions with residual hyperpigmentation and erythema, consistent with treatment response. Although the violaceous, bruise-like cutaneous nodules are characteristic of blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm, the diagnosis requires skin or marrow biopsy demonstrating CD4+, CD56+, CD123+, TCL1+ blasts.
